ctx.x: We were very good friends. I don't know, don't forget in 1954 I went to California. I was working with Kid Ora to hang over. Lou used to come there and play that town, play concert that town. When he'd get off that night he'd come right there. He'd sit down at the ball, stand behind the ball. Sit over there on the side where I'd be playing, you know? Waiting for him to get out and go talk. How you doing? Yeah. Telling me how I would talk.

items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Kato Oro picked him up. And took him in a band... Kid Oro took him in the band.

ctx.x: Nice to meet you. So, you went to Montgomery with Jack Carey? Yeah, Montgomery with Jack Carey.
